page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on KVM virtualization. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs powered by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processors built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration offers balanced compute and memory capacity for enterprise workloads requiring extensive multi-threading.

The instance provides a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps. It contains no integrated local storage, requiring the use of external cloud storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent file systems. It includes no hardware GPU accelerators and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, keeping resource overhead isolated strictly to standard central processing and memory operations.

Resource allocation maintains a stable core-to-memory ratio, optimizing utilization efficiency for large-scale application tiers. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is fitted for enterprise application servers, container cluster worker nodes, distributed intermediate databases, continuous integration and build environments, and batch data transformation workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance built on KVM virtualization and powered by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processors using the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 52 dedicated virtual CPUs and 192.0 GB of memory, resulting in an allocation of 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage, depending entirely on external block storage services, and contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Without included public IPv4 addresses, network ingress and egress rely on separate network configurations. The resource profile provides a standard multi-core general-purpose balance, minimizing core-to-memory imbalances for medium-to-large deployments. This makes the ecs.g6.13xlarge suitable for enterprise application backends, container orchestration nodes, multi-tier web hosting, continuous integration and build servers, and batch data processing pipelines.
